shared_elements: frontal or profile standing figure with elaborate headgear (B) vs. profile figures with headdresses (A)
animal forms (A: bovid/horse; B: zoomorphic mask motifs)
justification: Both surfaces depict human figures in relief accompanied by bordering ornamental bands, but that is a generic correspondence: A shows long horizontal registers of profile figures walking in file, leading animals and carrying objects, while B shows a single frontal, richly costumed figure enclosed within an ornate vertical frame of dense glyph-like and mask motifs. The relationships (a procession of many toward a common direction versus one enclosed central personage) and the proportional and detailing conventions (spare, elongated profile figures versus squat, densely elaborated frontal figure) are quite different.
